image:image.image:title: Photo Album - Kesh Musicians, photo by Brian Attebery
image:image.image:caption: At Mythcon XIX, in Berkeley, in 1988, a group of very brave people performed the Kesh dance-masque "The Plumed Water," from the text in my Always Coming Home. This picture is of the musicians. The drummer, wearing typical Kesh clothing, is the poet Ire of Sinshan. The player of the houmbuta or great horn is the famous composer, instrument-maker, and performer Tabit of Ashland. If anyone can tell me the names of the singers, one of whom holds a darbagatush or handhitter, I will happily include them in this caption. The picture was taken, and given to us, by Brian Attebery of Pocatello. —Ursula K. Le Guin

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel - Chapter 1
image:image.image:caption: After escaping from the apartment house, Jane flew to the other side of the city to visit with her mother and Sarah for a while. (Drawing by Collin.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Then Jane decided it was time to head back to Overhill Farm. She missed the other catwings — Roger, Harriet, Thelma, and James. Jane missed her friend Alexander most of all. (Drawing by Jake.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Jane kissed her mother goodbye and flew off to Overhill Farm. When she got there, the other cats were so glad to see her. They licked her and kissed her all over. Alexander was the happiest of all. (Drawing by Casey.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: When night came, they went to sleep in the hay barn. Alexander stayed in the barn instead of going to sleep in the farmhouse. In the middle of the night something strange happened. Alexander woke up and felt very funny. He didn't know what was wrong. (Drawing by Mat.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel - Chapter 2
image:image.image:caption: When the cats woke up in the morning, they saw an amazing sight -- Alexander had grown wings! All the catwings cheered. Alexander started doing a dance because he was really, really happy! Alexander started running. Then he spread his wings and jumped up. Alexander could fly! (Drawing by Catelin.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Roger, Thelma, Harriet, James, and Jane couldn't believe their eyes. They all flew around Alexander. “Oh, Alexander,” said Jane. “I love you.” ”I love you, too, Jane,” said Alexander. ”Jane, will you be my wife?” asked Alexander. ”Yes, Alexander!” said Jane. The catwings were all very happy. (Drawing by Brooke.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: “I have an idea,” said Thelma. “Let's all fly back to the city so our mother can meet Alexander!” ”That's a great idea,” said the rest of the catwings. (Drawing by Henry.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel - Chapter 3
image:image.image:caption: So the six catwings — Roger, Thelma, Harriet, James, Jane, and Alexander flew off to the city to visit Mrs. Jane Tabby. (Drawing by Ben.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: It was a very long trip. The catwings stopped at the same places along the way. They even saw the owl that had frightened Alexander before. "I'm not afraid of you anymore," said Alexander. He chased the owl far away from the other catwings. (Drawing by Dalin.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Alexander was not watching how far he was flying. He turned to go back but he realized he was lost. "I know," said Alexander. "I'll use my Homing Instinct." He thought for a moment and headed off in one direction. In a few minutes he was back safely with the other catwings. "We were beginning to get a little worried about you, Alexander," said Jane. "I'm just fine!" said Alexander. (Drawing by Jade.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel - Chapter 4
image:image.image:caption: After a short while they could see the tall buildings of the city. They landed on the buildings with the flowerpots on top. (Drawing by Kaitlyn.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: They found Mrs. Jane Tabby asleep in Sarah's arms. "Mother, Mother," sang Thelma and Roger. "We're here to see you," said Harriet and James. "Open your eyes!" called Jane and Alexander. (Drawing by Clay.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Mrs. Jane Tabby opened one eye and then the other. She couldn't believe her eyes. "Children," she cried, "You are all here together." "And who are you?" she said to Alexander. "You have wings but you are not my child!" (Drawing by Emma.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: "Mother," said Jane, "This is our good friend Alexander. He used to be a regular cat. But one night Alexander slept with us in the barn. When he woke up in the morning, he had wings! We don't know how it happened." "It's nice to meet you, Alexander," said Mrs. Jane Tabby. "It's great to finally meet you, Mrs. Tabby," said Alexander, "I've heard so much about you." (Drawing by Sonny.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: "Mother," said Jane shyly, "We have a surprise for you. Alexander and I are married!" "That's wonderful," purred Jane Tabby. When she tried to get up from Sarah's lap, the catwings could see that Jane tabby was in a lot of pain. "What's wrong, Mother?" asked Roger and James. "Oh, my dears, I am just getting very, very old," she said sadly. (Drawing by Nicholas.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: "I have an idea," said Harriet. "Let's take Mother back to Overhill Farm to live with us!" Everyone thought that was a great idea, especially Mrs. Jane Tabby. (Drawing by Linden.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel - Chapter 5
image:image.image:caption: The next day, Jane Tabby said goodbye to Sarah Wolf. The catwings headed back to Overhill Farm. They each took a turn carrying their mother on their backs. They got back home in no time. (Drawing by Jailee.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Hank and Susan couldn't believe their eyes when they saw all the catwings flying into the barn. Alexander was carrying Mrs. Jane Tabby on his back. (Drawing by Wyatt.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: "Well," said Hank, "It looks like we have some big changes around here!" They brought some food for all the catwings and Mrs. Jane Tabby. Then they left them alone to rest. (Drawing by Anika.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel - Chapter 6
image:image.image:caption: In the morning, the catwings woke up early. They were feeling very happy. "It's so nice to all be together now," said Roger. "We have some wonderful news," said Jane and Alexander. "We are going to have a little kitten!" "We want to name her Angel." All the catwings cheered. (Drawing by April.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 5 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Mrs. Jane Tabby looked the happiest of all. "That means, my dear catwings, I am going to be... a GRANDMA!" (Drawing by Bethany.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel - Catwings 6: Grandma Jane and her Grandkittens

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel - Letter dated December 17, 2003
image:image.image:caption: Dear Ursula Le Guin, We have written a new catwings book! We think you'll really enjoy it. Thank you for writing the other Catwings books. We really like it when our teacher reads them to us. We hope you have very happy holidays. Love, Mrs. Katz's First Grade Class

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel - Chapter 1
image:image.image:caption: Mrs. Jane Tabby was happy to be living at Overhill Farm with her children. She was so excited that Jane and Alexander were going to have a baby kitten. Soon she would be a grandma! (Drawing by Ashley.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: One night, the catwings were fast asleep in the barn. Jane woke up and felt a little rumbly in her tummy. She woke up Alexander. He was wondering if the baby kitten was going to be born. (Drawing by Katie.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Jane and Alexander woke up Harriet and James. Then they woke up Thelma, Roger, and Mrs. Jane Tabby. In just a little while, Jane had her baby, Angel! (Drawing by Garrett .)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: But then Jane started feeling rumbly in her tummy, again! Soon she had another baby kitten, and then another. (Drawing by Scout.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: All the catwings were very excited and surprised. "I thought you were only going to have one kitten," said Mrs. Jane Tabby. "But you had three — two girls and one boy!" (Drawing by Shaylee.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: The baby kittens were so cute. Their eyes were closed and they looked like little mice. “Please help us name the other kittens,” said Jane and Alexander. Everyone thought for a long time. Then they all decided to name the other kittens Crystal and Alex. (Drawing by Wyatt.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel - Chapter Two
image:image.image:caption: The baby catwings grew very quickly. Angel was white, Alex was brown, and Crystal was black and… (Drawing by Jacob.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: They all had wings! Soon they were flying around Overhill Farm with their mom and dad and their aunts and uncles. Mrs. Jane Tabby was so proud of her new grandkittens! (Drawing by Tres.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel - Chapter Three
image:image.image:caption: One day, Mrs. Jane Tabby woke up very early. She was feeling great and she wanted to go for a walk by herself. All the catwings were fast asleep. She left very quietly. (Drawing by Kasandra.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: Mrs. Jane Tabby walked for a long time. She felt very tired so she decided to take a short nap. (Drawing by Chase B.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: When the catwings woke up, they didn't see Mrs. Jane Tabby. They were very worried. (Drawing by Natalie.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: “We'll go and look for her,” cried Alex, Angel, and Crystal. ”Are you sure?” asked Jane and Alexander ”Yes!” said the kittens. (Drawing by Veona.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel - Chapter Four
image:image.image:caption: The kittens flew off into the woods. ”Grandma, Grandma,” they called. There was no answer. (Drawing by Chase D.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: The kittens flew for a long time. They were getting very tired so they flew down to rest. (Drawing by Wes.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: They walked over to a river to get a drink of water. They saw Grandma Jane fast asleep in a pile of leaves next to the river. (Drawing by Garrett.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: “Grandma Jane, are you all right?” said the kittens. Mrs. Jane Tabby woke up. ”Why yes, my dears. I am fine. I guess I took a very long nap!” (Drawing by Bryson.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel - Chapter Five
image:image.image:caption: “Let's go home, Grandma," said Angel. "Everyone is very worried about you.” The kittens walked Grandma Jane back to the farm. (Drawing by Mackenzie.)

image:image.image:title: Catwings 6 Fan Sequel
image:image.image:caption: All the other catwings were so happy to see her. ”I promise I won't go wandering off ever again without my wonderful grandkittens!” said Mrs. Jane Tabby. (Drawing by Jolene.)
